items.title: Nevada regulator calls CFTC prediction market swap distinction a distinction without a difference, BitcoinCasinos reports
items.content_text: - **Nevada regulator calls CFTC prediction market swap distinction a distinction without a difference, BitcoinCasinos reports** — Nevada gaming regulator Dreitzer said the CFTC proposal to classify event contracts as swaps makes no practical difference, comparing a 10 dollar bet on an NFL game with a 10 dollar contract on the same outcome as effectively identical transactions. He also argued that exiting a position early does not set event contracts apart, because online sportsbooks have long offered cash-out features. ([BitcoinCasinos](https://www.bitcoincasinos.com/blog/2026/10/18/nevada-regulator-cftc-prediction-markets-distinction/))

items.title: Polymarket Protocol V2 set for November 2 mainnet switchover, Bonus reports
items.content_text: - **Polymarket Protocol V2 set for November 2 mainnet switchover, Bonus reports** — Polymarket will fully switch its platform to Protocol V2 on November 2, replacing its original 2019 Gnosis CTF foundation. The upgrade consolidates various market types into a single ERC-1155 position contract, transitions to pUSD as the sole collateral, and introduces a multi-oracle aggregator supporting Chainlink and UMA, with live canary markets running from October 5 through October 30 for testing. ([Bonus](https://www.bonus.com/news/polymarket-sets-nov-2-mainnet-switchover-for-protocol-v2/))

items.title: NBER study finds no systematic political bias in election prediction market prices, RotoWire reports
items.content_text: - **NBER study finds no systematic political bias in election prediction market prices, RotoWire reports** — An October 2026 NBER working paper by Eric Zitzewitz analyzed what the author believes is the largest sample of election prediction markets ever assembled, spanning 1880 to 2025 and covering venues including the Iowa Electronic Markets, Intrade, PredictIt, Betfair, and Kalshi. The full-sample estimate of partisan bias was essentially zero, and no robustness check showed a statistically significant tilt. items.content_text: - **Oklahoma tribe denies partnering with Kalshi for prediction market app, Global Gaming Insider reports** — The Alabama-Quassarte Tribal Town of Oklahoma has denied entering into a partnership with Kalshi to develop a prediction market app, in a statement shared by Indian Gaming Association conference chair Victor Rocha.
